Teams create and manage purchase orders, track goods received and true landed costs, collect and approve bills, pay vendors with real-time visibility, and access flexible inventory and growth financing ($20K-$15M) underwritten from payables and purchasing data. Founded in 2019 and backed by Ribbit Capital, Kleiner Perkins, and Founders Fund, Settle has funded more than $3 billion to brands. A developer API covering bill pay, payments, and landed-cost data is in early access via a public waitlist.

providers.name: Simon Property Group
providers.description: Simon Property Group is the largest retail real estate investment trust (REIT) in the United States, owning, developing, and managing premier shopping, dining, entertainment, and mixed-use destinations. Simon's portfolio includes an interest in 254 properties: traditional malls, premium outlets, Mills centers, lifestyle centers, and other retail properties in North America, Europe, and Asia. The company operates ShopSimon, an e-commerce platform, and Simon Innovation Group to advance retail technology innovation. Simon had trailing twelve-month revenue of approximately $6.36 billion as of 2025 and a market capitalization of approximately $67 billion.

providers.name: Starshipit
providers.description: Starshipit is a shipping and fulfilment platform that helps retailers automate label creation, manage over 60 carriers, and send shipping notifications, delivering better customer experiences across Australia and New Zealand. The service offers a free trial, integrated pricing, and extensive support resources for eCommerce businesses.

providers.name: Vela Labs
providers.description: Vela Labs, Inc. (Vela, formerly Hive) is a San Francisco company founded in 2018 by Justin Killian and Jason Abaluck that provides an AI-driven platform helping eCommerce sellers manage, optimize, and grow their businesses across multiple channels from a single account. Vela supports Etsy, Shopify, eBay, and Faire, offering bulk listing editing, AI-assisted listing creation and optimization, photo editing, and multi-channel publishing for tens of thousands of sellers. A 500 Global portfolio company that has raised $5.5M. Vela consumes the official APIs of the marketplaces it supports but publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable surface of its own.

providers.name: Duroflexworld
providers.description: Duroflex (duroflexworld.com) is one of India's most trusted sleep-solutions brands, selling mattresses, sofas, recliners, beds, pillows and mattress protectors direct-to-consumer with up to a 10-year warranty, free shipping and EMI options. The online store runs on Shopify and exposes real agent-facing commerce surfaces discovered by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline: a hosted Storefront MCP server at /api/mcp (catalog search, cart, product details, and shop policy/FAQ tools that conform to the UCP catalog capability) and a Shopify Customer Account API secured with OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, advertising an agent-oriented customer-account-mcp-api scope. Surfaced originally as a Norwest Venture Partners portfolio lead, the profile is now enriched with its MCP, well-known OIDC discovery, authentication, scopes and domain-security artifacts.

providers.name: HNI
providers.description: HNI Corporation (NYSE: HNI) is a manufacturer founded in 1944 and headquartered in Muscatine, Iowa, built around two operating segments. Workplace Furnishings makes office seating, desks, storage, tables, panel systems and ancillary furnishings sold through independent dealers under the HON, Allsteel, Gunlocke, HBF and Kimball International brands. Residential Building Products is the hearth business, operated by Hearth & Home Technologies under the Heatilator, Heat & Glo, Majestic, Monessen, Quadra-Fire, Harman, SimpliFire and PelPro brands. HNI publishes no developer portal, REST API or OpenAPI for either segment. Its one public machine-readable surface is the agent-commerce stack on the Hearth & Home Technologies storefront at hearthnhome.com, which serves an llms.txt, a Universal Commerce Protocol merchant profile and an anonymous MCP endpoint exposing 13 catalog, cart and checkout tools.

providers.name: Level Frames
providers.description: Level Frames is a New York City based online custom framing company founded in 2014 by Josh Hubball and Damian Sowers and backed by Y Combinator (Winter 2015). The company lets customers design and order handcrafted, made-to-order picture frames from home, either by uploading a digital photo for printing and framing or by shipping in physical artwork, posters and prints. Its catalog covers custom frames, framed canvas prints, framed vinyl records, collage frames, gallery walls, personalized framed photos, and framed chalkboards, whiteboards and corkboards, alongside at-home and in-studio framing services. Level Frames operates a direct-to-consumer web storefront and publishes no public developer program, API, or SDK surface as of this profile.

providers.name: OLX
providers.description: OLX is a global online classifieds and marketplace operator, part of OLX Group (owned by Prosus / Naspers), running consumer buy-and-sell marketplaces across 30+ countries under 20+ brands including OLX Poland (olx.pl), OLX Brazil (olx.com.br), OLX Portugal, OLX Bulgaria and OLX Romania, spanning general classifieds, motors/autos, and real estate. OLX Poland publishes a public Partner API (OAuth2) that lets integrators and sellers manage adverts, categories/attributes, and delivery settings programmatically. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and General Catalyst and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Universe
providers.description: Universe is a no-code website builder that lets anyone design and publish a custom website from a phone, tablet, or computer, using a drag-and-drop GRID block system with built-in commerce, mail tools, analytics, and SEO. A 2023 Apple Design Award winner with more than one million sites built, Universe is a Y Combinator W18 company backed by GV and General Catalyst. Universe is a consumer creation platform and publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: CraftCoffee
providers.description: Craft Coffee is a direct-to-consumer specialty coffee company operating since 2011 that sources, roasts, and ships freshly roasted coffee to subscribers across the United States. Its storefront offers flexible, commitment-free coffee subscriptions plus one-off bags, gift subscriptions, and a preference-matching engine that recommends blends and single-origin coffees (Into the Black, Streetlight, Sumatra, Throwback, and more) based on customer taste. The business runs on a Shopify commerce stack with Shopify Customer Accounts for authenticated login; it is a consumer e-commerce brand and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation. Added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company for ongoing discovery and enrichment.

providers.name: dopamine 💊, the store where you shop without spending
providers.description: Dopamine 💊 is an e‑commerce platform that promises the dopamine of buying without spending. It offers one‑tap checkout that pays itself, live worldwide tracking, and an invoice that never arrives. The site markets 100% fake products but claims 100% real dopamine, positioning itself as a playful, hyper‑convenient shopping experience.

providers.name: HungryPanda
providers.description: HungryPanda (熊猫外卖) is the largest Asian food delivery platform serving overseas Chinese communities, founded in Nottingham, UK in 2017 and headquartered in London. It operates a marketplace app, a rider delivery network, the Panda Fresh Asian grocery e-commerce platform and the VouchersPanda lifestyle-deals platform across more than 80 cities in ten countries (UK, France, Italy, USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Japan, South Korea and Singapore). Its API surface is a regionally partitioned merchant/partner ordering platform used by POS and middleware integrators — Deliverect, Otter, Neopos, Hubster, Menusifu, Easy Cloud and Redcat — to inject HungryPanda orders into a restaurant point of sale, push order-status updates back, and sync menus. Integration credentials (App Key, Secret Key, ShopID) are issued by HungryPanda on a partner basis; there is no public developer portal, no published specification and no self-service sign-up.

providers.name: Quickpay
providers.description: Quickpay is a European payment service provider offering a RESTful API for online merchants to accept a wide range of payment methods, including cards, mobile wallets, and local schemes. It supports multi‑currency processing, recurring payments, and detailed reporting, serving thousands of merchants across the EU. The platform emphasizes security, compliance with PSD2, and easy integration via SDKs and documentation.

providers.name: True & Co
providers.description: True & Co is a direct-to-consumer women's intimates and lingerie brand, originally venture-backed (Cowboy Ventures, Uncork Capital) and now operating under PVH Corp. It sells bras, underwear, and loungewear online through a Shopify-hosted storefront at trueandco.com. The store exposes no traditional developer API, but it does expose a modern agent-commerce surface: a hosted Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint for catalog, cart, and checkout, Shopify Customer Account OAuth 2.0 / OIDC for buyer identity, a public read-only storefront JSON surface, and an agent-facing llms.txt / agents.md.

providers.name: ablefy
providers.description: ablefy (formerly elopage) is a German all-in-one sales and monetization platform for coaches, creators, trainers, consultants, and online educators. It provides conversion-optimized checkout with 12+ payment methods (PayPal, Klarna, SEPA, cards, Apple/Google Pay) across multiple currencies, an integrated LMS for online courses, memberships and subscriptions, community and live events, e-ticketing, automated invoicing with international tax/OSS compliance, and an optional reseller (merchant-of-record) model. Sellers can automate workflows through the ablefy API, webhooks, and access-token authentication, plus a Zapier integration and email-marketing connectors. The platform reports 80,000+ sellers, 6M+ customers serviced, and over EUR 2 billion in processed transactions across 13+ years of operation.

providers.name: AdCreator AI
providers.description: AdCreator AI is a Shopify app that uses artificial intelligence to generate advertising creatives for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and Google from product photos in about 60 seconds. It offers a free tier, a trial, and paid plans with multiple ad variants, and includes a tariff calculator for import duties. The platform also provides real‑time rate alerts via email, Slack, or webhook, and features tools like headline generation, ad rewriting, and brand voice assistance.

providers.name: Grailed
providers.description: Grailed is a peer-to-peer online marketplace for buying, selling, and discovering luxury, designer, vintage, and streetwear fashion for both men and women. Founded in 2013 and owned by GOAT Group, the platform lets independent sellers list clothing, footwear, accessories, and jewelry while Grailed facilitates the transaction, offering digital listing verification by trained moderators, purchase protection on qualifying orders, secure third-party payment processing (card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Klarna), and a community trust and seller-rating system. Grailed does not publish a public developer API; it exposes a consumer web and mobile experience, an agent-facing /llms.txt, and a RFC 9116 security.txt with a bug bounty program. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Yoona.ai
providers.description: Yoona.ai is an enterprise agentic-AI platform for product innovation, originally built for the fashion industry. It creates an adaptive "Enterprise Twin" of a brand by connecting PLM, ERP, e-commerce and market data into a single intelligence layer, then uses AI agents to autonomously generate product designs, optimize assortments and validate sell-through. Capabilities include text-to-image and sketch-to-design generation, trend and data analysis, and a Sales Confidence Algorithm. Integration with a customer's stack (Shopify to SAP) is offered via a flexible REST/GraphQL API, but that API is delivered as an Enterprise-tier custom integration — there is no public self-serve API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification published as of this enrichment pass. Backed by Techstars.

providers.name: Avant Arte
providers.description: Avant Arte is a global online art marketplace for discovering and collecting limited edition prints, sculptures and digital works produced in close collaboration with leading contemporary artists. Founded in the Netherlands, the platform works directly with 250+ artists on exclusive editions and release "draws", offering authentication, custom framing, gift cards, and expert collector support. It surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Prosus Ventures in the marketplaces sector. Avant Arte does not publish a public developer API; this profile has been enriched from its public web, security, and organizational surfaces.

providers.name: BoostedChat
providers.description: BoostedChat provides AI‑powered conversational agents that engage leads instantly on WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram. The platform offers proactive, personalized conversations that convert, with features like automated follow‑ups, scheduling, and multi‑channel support. It aims to make every customer feel like the only one, helping businesses increase engagement and sales through intelligent chat automation.

providers.name: Pendulumlife
providers.description: Pendulum (pendulumlife.com) is a direct-to-consumer probiotics and metabolic-health company founded by PhD scientists from Johns Hopkins, Harvard, Berkeley and Stanford. It sells next-generation probiotic supplements such as Metabolic Daily, Akkermansia, Glucose Control (a medical probiotic clinically shown to improve A1C in type 2 diabetes) and Polyphenol Booster. Surfaced as a portfolio company of felicis and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. Enrichment finding: the site is a Shopify-hosted storefront and Pendulum publishes no first-party developer API, SDKs, or documentation; the only machine surface is Shopify's platform customer-account OIDC discovery endpoint.

providers.name: Pricerunner
providers.description: Pricerunner is a product price-comparison platform founded in 1999 and owned by Klarna since 2022 (operated by Klarna Technologies AB). It helps shoppers compare prices and products across thousands of retailers in 13 countries (Sweden, Denmark, the UK, Norway, USA, Germany, Austria, Finland, France, Ireland, Italy, the Netherlands and Spain). Pricerunner markets a product-and-price-data API for retailers and businesses covering product search, competitor analysis, price history and automatic price matching across roughly 126 million daily-updated prices, but access is gated behind a sales contact form, with no public developer documentation, OpenAPI specification, or self-serve onboarding published.

providers.name: Shopventory
providers.description: Thrive by Shopventory is inventory management, catalog control, and reporting software for small and medium-sized retail, restaurant, and hospitality businesses. Founded in 2012 out of a San Diego boutique and a graduate of the Techstars Boulder accelerator, Shopventory syncs stock, sales, and cost-of-goods data across multiple locations and sales channels, and integrates with Square, Shopify, Clover, BigCommerce, WooCommerce, and QuickBooks Online. The platform offers barcode scanning, purchase-order automation, demand forecasting, bundles and component-level tracking, price-tag printing, and advanced custom reporting. The company operates as Thrive by Shopventory (thrivemetrics.com). Its former public developer API (apidocs.shopventory.com) is no longer resolvable, so this profile captures the company's live web, support, and integration surface plus probed domain-security posture rather than a public API specification.

providers.name: SKUPLUGS
providers.description: SKUPlugs provides a no‑code solution to sync inventory, products and orders across major POS and e‑commerce platforms such as Lightspeed, Square, Loyverse, Zoho, Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon and Walmart. Users can connect their POS, configure mappings, and automate inventory synchronization without writing code, benefiting from a 15‑day free trial and multi‑channel support.

providers.name: kalicart-com
providers.description: KaliCart provides an open‑agentic commerce network for WooCommerce stores, exposing product catalogs through a read‑only, ARC/1.0 compliant API. Merchants install the free KaliCart Bridge plugin to make their catalog machine‑readable, while AI agents query the federated KaliCart Global discovery service to retrieve offers without handling checkout. The platform emphasizes privacy, provenance, and UCP alignment, offering free GPL‑v2 bridge software, a specification, and MCP endpoints for AI integration.

providers.name: Local Line
providers.description: Local Line is a farm‑to‑fork commerce platform that enables producers, distributors, grocers, and restaurants to buy and sell local food directly. Trusted by leading farms and retailers, it offers built‑in reporting, traceability, and integrations with ERP, POS, and e‑commerce tools, helping create a transparent, efficient local food supply chain.

providers.name: OZON.ru
providers.description: OZON is one of Russia's largest e-commerce marketplaces, offering retail across electronics, apparel, groceries, and more, plus its own logistics and fulfillment network (FBO/FBS). For developers, OZON exposes the OZON Seller API, a POST-based RPC-over-HTTP JSON API at https://api-seller.ozon.ru that lets marketplace sellers manage products, prices, stock, warehouses, orders, returns, analytics, and finances programmatically. Authentication uses two headers, a numeric Client-Id and a secret Api-Key issued in the seller cabinet. OZON was surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from live probes of its API host and public developer documentation.

providers.name: Foraged
providers.description: Foraged is a community marketplace for wild and specialty foods, connecting independent foragers, farmers, fishers, and artisan food producers directly with home cooks and professional chefs across the United States. Founded in 2021 and built on a custom Medusa commerce stack, Foraged provides an end-to-end platform covering vendor storefronts, product listings, shipping logistics, and secure payment processing for hard-to-source ingredients like wild mushrooms, truffles, foraged berries, sea vegetables, and other specialty foods. Sellers manage their entire shop from a vendor dashboard while buyers discover seasonal wild foods through the marketplace website and mobile app. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Foraged publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Paz Ai
providers.description: Paz.ai is an AI commerce platform that helps merchants win visibility and sales across AI shopping channels such as ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, and Perplexity. It runs three autonomous agents — a Monitor agent that benchmarks catalog performance across AI channels, an Optimizer agent that enriches product titles, attributes, and structured data, and a Distributor agent that publishes AI-optimized feeds to agentic commerce endpoints — producing an AI-optimized copy of a product catalog without modifying the live store. It integrates with Shopify, Adobe Commerce, and Salesforce Commerce, plus CSV and a custom API on enterprise plans. Backed by Mayfield.

providers.name: Teabox
providers.description: Teabox is a premium loose-leaf tea brand and direct-to-consumer e-commerce company backed by Accel. It sources fresh Darjeeling, Assam, Nilgiri and other Indian teas direct from gardens and ships them globally through its online store. The storefront runs on Shopify, which exposes an agent-commerce surface built on the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP): a hosted shopping MCP endpoint, a machine-readable llms.txt / agents.md, and OpenID Connect authentication via the Shopify Customer Account API (including a customer-account MCP scope). Buyer checkout always requires explicit human approval. This profile was surfaced as an Accel portfolio company and enriched from Teabox's public agent-facing surfaces.

providers.name: Catch Co / Mystery Tackle Box
providers.description: Mystery Tackle Box, a division of Catch Co, offers a monthly fishing tackle subscription service delivering curated selections of lures, baits, and accessories to anglers across the United States. Founded to simplify the hobby, the company provides flexible plans ranging from beginner to elite tiers, each featuring species-specific assortments, exclusive gear, and educational content. The platform operates an e‑commerce storefront, supports gift subscriptions, and engages customers through a blog and community resources, aiming to enhance the fishing experience for enthusiasts of all skill levels.

providers.name: Gyft
providers.description: Gyft is a digital gift card platform and marketplace (a Fiserv / First Data company) for buying, sending, storing, and redeeming digital gift cards from more than 250 retail brands. Consumers use the Gyft web app and mobile apps to consolidate and manage gift cards, while businesses use the Gyft API and Gyft SDK to add digital gift cards to their own apps, websites, employee rewards, and incentive programs, and to place bulk corporate orders through Gyft Business. Developer and API access is provisioned to enrolled partners via the Gyft developer portal. Surfaced originally as a portfolio company of 500 Global and GV, and enriched here from Gyft's public developer surface.

providers.name: KiwiCo
providers.description: KiwiCo, Inc. is a direct-to-consumer education company headquartered in Mountain View, California, founded in 2011 by Sandra Oh Lin. KiwiCo designs and ships hands-on STEAM (science, technology, engineering, art and math) project kits — branded as crates — on a monthly subscription, with distinct lines aimed at every age from infants through teens and adults, alongside single-purchase kits sold through its online store. A KiwiCo Education division supplies the same project kits and NGSS-aligned lesson guides to schools, homeschools, after-school programs and camps. KiwiCo operates as a consumer e-commerce and subscription business and publishes no public developer program: there is no developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI definition, SDK, CLI or webhook surface, and no /.well-known/ discovery documents on any of its hosts. This profile therefore captures verified company identity and public web properties only.

providers.name: Casper
providers.description: Casper (Casper Sleep Inc.) is a direct-to-consumer sleep and home goods brand that sells mattresses, bedding, pillows, and sleep accessories online at casper.com and through retail partners. Its casper.com storefront runs on Shopify and exposes a modern agentic-commerce surface: a published llms.txt/agents.md with agent instructions, the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile, a UCP shopping MCP endpoint for AI agents to search, cart, and check out, and Shopify Customer Account API OpenID Connect authentication. Casper was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of IVP and Slow Ventures and enriched from its live public agent/commerce surface.

providers.name: Circulo de Belleza
providers.description: Círculo de Belleza is an authorized distributor of professional beauty products in Mexico, operating an e-commerce storefront at circulodebelleza.com. It sells salon-quality hair care, hair color, nail, barbershop, and facial/spa supplies from 40+ professional brands (L'Oréal Professionnel, Olaplex, Wella, Schwarzkopf, Matrix, Alfaparf Milano) at professional pricing with no minimum purchase, same-day fulfillment, and nationwide Mexico delivery. The store is built on Shopify and exposes a native agent-commerce surface: a published llms.txt/agents.md, OpenID Connect and OAuth authorization-server discovery documents, and a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint for agent-driven catalog search, cart, and buyer-approved checkout.

providers.name: Everything But The House
providers.description: Everything But The House (EBTH) is a Blue Ash, Ohio online estate sale and consignment auction marketplace founded in 2008 by Jacquie Denny and Brian Graves. It runs curated, full-service online estate sales — cataloging, photography, appraisal, payment and shipping — for homeowners, estate managers, dealers and collectors, and sells the resulting antiques, fine art, jewelry, coins, watches, furniture and collectibles to buyers through timed online auctions where most lots open at one dollar. EBTH sells a consumer marketplace and a consignment service, not a developer platform: the company publishes no developer portal, API reference, machine-readable specification, SDK or webhook catalog. Its public GitHub organization contains only forks of third-party Ruby gems, its mobile apps are webview wrappers around ebth.com, and the only GraphQL endpoint on the site is an internal one that robots.txt disallows. The single machine-facing surface it does operate is a public Uptime Kuma status page at status.ebth.com.

providers.name: Vuori
providers.description: Vuori is a California-based performance athletic apparel and activewear brand founded in 2015 in Encinitas, offering men's and women's clothing built for training, running, yoga, and everyday wear. The direct-to-consumer business runs on a Shopify storefront at vuoriclothing.com plus a growing retail footprint, and is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners (and later SoftBank Vision Fund). Vuori publishes no public developer API or developer portal; it exposes a consumer web/mobile storefront, a help center, and a brand blog. This API Evangelist profile captures the company's real public web surface — its security.txt vulnerability-disclosure contact, domain-security posture, and customer-facing pages — rather than a developer program, which does not exist.

providers.name: Aunt Flow
providers.description: Aunt Flow is a woman-owned company on a mission to end period poverty by making menstrual products freely accessible in public restrooms the same way toilet paper is. It manufactures and sells free-vend period product dispensers (models P, E, R, and O), organic cotton tampons and pads, touch-free disposal systems, and retail display boxes, serving schools, universities, offices, airports, stadiums, ski resorts, restaurants, health systems, amusement parks, and coworking spaces. Since 2021 the company has donated over 6 million period products to people in need. Aunt Flow is a physical-products and e-commerce business (Techstars-backed) with no public developer API surface; this profile captures its identity, commercial links, and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Caer
providers.description: Caer, Inc. is the company behind YUMI (helloyumi.com), a direct-to-consumer children's nutrition brand that makes nutritionally-engineered organic snacks for babies, toddlers, and kids. The product line includes toddler bars, squeezable smoothies-to-go, freeze-dried smoothie melts, super/breakfast bars, and soft-baked cookies, all formulated as function-first, nutrient-dense, organic, dairy-free, gluten-free, and clean-label. YUMI sells through its own WooCommerce storefront, Amazon, and select retail, offering one-time purchases and recurring subscription memberships. Backed by 500 Global. This profile was seeded as a venture-portfolio stub; it is a consumer packaged-goods e-commerce brand with no first-party public developer API, so most API-artifact scoring dimensions are not applicable.

providers.name: Gobble
providers.description: Gobble is a meal-kit delivery service that ships chef-prepped dinner kits designed to be cooked in about fifteen minutes, marketed as "restaurant-level delicious in minutes." The company preps and portions seasonal ingredients before shipping them in refrigerated boxes to customers' doorsteps, and offers three flexible subscription plans - Classic, Lean & Clean (650 calories or less, low carb, lean proteins), and Vegetarian - with no long-term commitment. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Gobble operates a direct-to-consumer subscription business and does not currently publish a public developer program, API, or developer documentation. This profile captures its public web presence for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: hobbyDB
providers.description: hobbyDB is a database and marketplace for collectibles — a platform that lets anyone catalog, offer, buy, and sell just about any collectible (Funko Pops, action figures, trading cards, die-cast, and more) at any time, from anywhere, in auction-style or fixed-price formats. It pairs a community-curated reference database of collectible items and variants with personal collection-management tools (lists, condition and grading tracking, pre-orders, trades, and import/export) and a peer-to-peer marketplace for transactions between collectors. hobbyDB is a Techstars-backed company.

providers.name: Italic
providers.description: Italic is a direct-to-consumer home goods brand founded in 2018, bringing Mediterranean-inspired beauty to everyday living. The company sells premium bedding, bath towels and robes, beach cabana towels, cashmere throws, decor, and kitchenware (chef knives and flatware), organized into themed collections such as Havana, Amalfi, and Riviera. Italic operates a membership program, "Italic Bold," and runs a Shopify-based storefront with a customer help center, wholesale and trade programs, and an active blog. Backed by venture investors including Canaan Partners and Kindred Ventures, Italic is a consumer e-commerce retailer with no public developer API surface; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity, website properties, and domain security posture.

providers.name: Joor
providers.description: JOOR is a New York-based SaaS company (founded 2010) operating a leading B2B wholesale fashion commerce platform and digital marketplace that connects fashion brands with retailers to run their wholesale business end to end. The platform digitizes wholesale buying with online linesheets, lookbooks, virtual showrooms, order management, and the JOOR Marketplace, alongside products such as JOOR Pay (wholesale payments), JOOR Passport (virtual trade shows), and Retail data/analytics. JOOR connects thousands of brands with hundreds of thousands of retail doors globally. Its production platform is fronted by a Kong API gateway and secured with Keycloak-based OpenID Connect authentication; API access is partner/integration-oriented rather than a self-serve public developer program. This profile was enriched from JOOR's live public surface (OIDC discovery, GitHub organization, and status page).

providers.name: Trendsi
providers.description: Trendsi is a wholesale clothing supplier and dropshipping platform for online fashion retailers, boutiques, and social-commerce creators. Delivered primarily as a Shopify app and a TikTok Shop integration, Trendsi lets sellers source trendy apparel — dresses, tops, and activewear — and offer dropshipping, open-pack wholesale, private labeling, and made-to-order fulfillment with no upfront inventory. The platform handles sourcing, warehousing, packing, and shipping under the retailer's own brand, with competitive wholesale pricing and fast US shipping. Sellers manage their catalog, orders, and fulfillment from the Trendsi seller portal at app.trendsi.com. Trendsi does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; integration with a merchant's store is delivered through its Shopify and TikTok Shop apps.

providers.name: 1stdibs
providers.description: 1stDibs is an online marketplace for luxury antiques, vintage and modern furniture, fine art, jewelry, watches, and fashion. It connects a global network of vetted sellers and design dealers with buyers seeking curated, authenticated high-end goods, backed by purchase-protection and authenticity guarantees. 1stDibs does not operate a public REST/OpenAPI developer program; its documented machine-facing surface is an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, registered as com.1stdibs/1stDibs, that lets agents browse and search the marketplace.

providers.name: 42 Technologies
providers.description: 42 Technologies is a retail business-intelligence and reporting platform, founded in 2013, that consolidates omnichannel retail data — point-of-sale, ecommerce, wholesale, and online-marketplace sources — into a single unified dashboard. It provides merchandisers, buyers, and retail executives with more than 100 purpose-built retail metrics, NRF retail-calendar-aware analytics, multi-currency support, and automated reporting, integrating with 100+ systems including Shopify, NetSuite, Amazon, Walmart, Magento, and WooCommerce. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global; 42 does not publish a public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Invaluable
providers.description: Invaluable is the world's leading online marketplace for fine art, antiques and collectibles, founded in 1986. The platform aggregates live and timed auctions from more than 5,000 premier auction houses across 53 countries, giving collectors worldwide a single place to discover, bid on, and win items — with over 260,000 items listed at any time and an archive of 66+ million price records. Invaluable also operates AuctionZip and a Private Label / Connect white-label offering, and provides a partner-only Catalog Upload API that lets auction-management software companies add, edit, and delete lots in timed and live sales directly from their own systems. The company is backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Unicommerce
providers.description: Unicommerce is India’s #1 e‑commerce enablement SaaS platform for order management, warehouse management, and multi‑channel inventory operations. It offers a cloud‑based solution to streamline order processing, inventory syncing across marketplaces, and fulfillment, helping merchants scale their online businesses. Book a free demo today.

providers.name: LiveAuctioneers
providers.description: LiveAuctioneers is the world's largest online marketplace for fine art, antiques, jewelry, collectibles, and luxury goods, connecting bidders with thousands of vetted auction houses worldwide. Founded in 2002 and headquartered in New York, it is part of Auction Technology Group (ATG). The platform offers live and timed online bidding, absentee and proxy bids, an auction-results and price-research database, seller consignment services, and an auctioneer partner portal. It is included in the API Evangelist network as a consumer-marketplace company profile surfaced from the Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio; it does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Route
providers.description: Route is a post-purchase platform for e-commerce brands that helps merchants own the customer experience after checkout. Its core products are package protection (shipping insurance covering lost, stolen, or damaged orders), AI-driven returns that reduce refunds and returns fraud, and real-time order and package tracking for shoppers. Route serves both merchants and their customers through storefront widgets, a mobile app, and a developer API documented on Stoplight. The company is backed by Craft Ventures.

providers.name: Brightpearl
providers.description: Brightpearl provides a cloud‑based retail operating system for multichannel ecommerce businesses, offering inventory, order, accounting, CRM, and analytics capabilities. The platform helps retailers streamline operations, integrate with major ecommerce marketplaces, and gain real‑time insights to improve efficiency and customer experience.

providers.name: Chewy
providers.description: Chewy, Inc. is a Fortune 500 American online retailer of pet food, pet products, prescription medications, and veterinary services headquartered in Plantation, Florida. Chewy is one of the largest e-commerce pet retailers in the United States and supports a customer-focused operating model centered on subscription Autoship orders, Chewy Pharmacy prescription fulfillment, Connect with a Vet telehealth, and Chewy Health insurance. Chewy provides vendor and supplier integration primarily through the Dsco supplier integration platform rather than a public consumer-facing developer API. The Dsco-based integration supports core EDI transactions for purchase orders, inventory updates, shipment confirmations, and invoices, enabling brands and third-party logistics providers to connect with Chewy's e-commerce marketplace.

providers.name: profitpather-com
providers.description: Profitpather provides AI‑powered analytics for Shopify stores, turning e‑commerce data into real‑time insights that can be queried by large language models like Claude and Codex. By installing a simple pixel, merchants gain unsampled, privacy‑first event tracking, customizable dashboards, and the ability to ask natural‑language questions about sales, traffic, and customer behavior. The platform offers a free tier with basic tools and a paid Pro plan with full history, unlimited tool access, and integration across multiple AI assistants.

providers.name: Backbone
providers.description: Backbone is a mobile gaming company that makes the Backbone One controller — a snap-on gamepad for iPhone and Android — and the Backbone app, a mobile gaming platform that unifies a player's game library across cloud gaming, console Remote Play, and streaming services with game discovery, capture, and social features. The company sells hardware and accessories through a Shopify-hosted storefront (backbone.com) that exposes an agent-commerce surface via the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint and Shopify Customer Account OIDC. Backbone is a portfolio company of Index Ventures. This profile was enriched from Backbone's public web surface; the company publishes no first-party developer API.

providers.name: Barn2Door
providers.description: Barn2Door is a Seattle-based commerce and business-management platform purpose-built for independent farmers and local food producers. It gives farms an online store, order and subscription management, inventory tracking, delivery and pickup logistics, integrated payments, and built-in marketing and customer-relationship tools, consolidating the systems a farm needs to sell direct-to-consumer and wholesale into a single dashboard. Barn2Door connects to partners including Mailchimp, QuickBooks Online, Stripe, Avalara, Shippo, Routific, Squarespace, and Facebook, but does not publish a public developer API or documentation portal at this time.

providers.name: DELLI
providers.description: DELLI is a UK online marketplace for independent food and drink makers, founded in 2022 by Depop founder Simon Beckerman with co-founder Marie Petrovicka. Often described as "the Depop for food," DELLI curates niche and small-batch products — snacks, sauces and condiments, pantry staples, drinks, alcohol, sweets and lifestyle goods — from micro-bakers, picklers, olive-oil producers and drink makers, and sells them to consumers, in part through a drop-style release model. The platform has since evolved into an AI-powered companion for makers and retailers, adding tools that cut the operational overhead of running a small food business. DELLI is backed by Balderton Capital and HV Capital, the original investors in Depop. The storefront runs on Shopify; DELLI publishes no first-party developer API at this time.

providers.name: GORGIE
providers.description: GORGIE is a direct-to-consumer beverage brand making a sparkling, zero-sugar energy drink with functional benefits from green tea, natural flavors, Biotin, B Vitamins, and L-Theanine — only 5 calories, no preservatives. Built by a women-led team on a mission to make wellness fun, GORGIE sells its variety of flavors through a Shopify-powered online store at getgorgie.com and on retail shelves including Target, supported by a store locator, wholesale program, and an Instagram/TikTok community. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of ggv-capital and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer packaged goods brand it exposes an ecommerce storefront and customer-account surface rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Prenetics
providers.description: Prenetics Global Limited (NASDAQ: PRE) is a consumer healthcare and longevity company whose flagship brand is IM8, a science-backed daily-nutrition and longevity supplement line co-founded with David Beckham that reached roughly $120M in annual recurring revenue within its first year. The company's IM8 Health direct-to-consumer storefront runs on Shopify and exposes an agent-native commerce surface: it publishes an /llms.txt agent guide and a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile at /.well-known/ucp that advertises a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) shopping endpoint, letting AI agents search the catalog, build carts, and drive buyer-approved checkout via Shop Pay, Google Pay, and Shopify card handlers. Prenetics itself publishes no separate developer/API program; the agent-commerce surface is the IM8 Health UCP/MCP storefront.

providers.name: Speero
providers.description: Speero (سبيرو) is Saudi Arabia's online marketplace for authentic automotive spare parts, accessories, and professional vehicle services. The platform helps car owners find OEM and aftermarket parts for their specific make and model across all major categories (engine, brakes, suspension, lighting, AC, exhaust, and more) and book maintenance, detailing, paint and dent repair, tinting, and tire care at trusted workshops across the Kingdom. It supports browse-by-vehicle, installment payment options, and WhatsApp-based customer support. Speero is a 500 Global portfolio company. It is a consumer marketplace and publishes no public developer API, but it does expose a machine-discovery surface (llms.txt, RFC 9116 security.txt, and an RFC 9727 api-catalog linkset).

providers.name: Yieldify *
providers.description: Yieldify is a website personalization and conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform for ecommerce brands, founded in 2013 in London by Jay Radia and backed by investors including GV (Google Ventures). Its SaaS platform delivers targeted on-site messaging, customer-journey personalization, and A/B testing to lift conversion and revenue. Yieldify was acquired by Publicis Groupe in January 2023 and folded into Epsilon, where it is now sold as Epsilon Accelerate; yieldify.com redirects to the Epsilon Accelerate product page and the legal entity behind the platform is Zeus Enterprise Ltd, trading as Yieldify. Delivery is entirely client-side: a customer-specific JavaScript tag placed before the closing head tag (directly, or via Google Tag Manager, Tealium, Shopify theme.liquid or Recharge checkout) renders a documented library of on-site experience components — overlays, notifications, banners, sticky and embedded experiences, toasters, carousels, countdown timers, lead-capture forms — configured from the Yieldify Conversion Platform at convert.yieldify.com, with a typed dynamic-expression language for personalized copy and client-side yieldify_impression/click/close/form_submit events pushed into the customer's own GA4 property. There is no public developer API: probing every Yieldify host on 2026-08-13 found no OpenAPI, GraphQL, MCP, A2A card, webhooks, SDK, CLI or developer portal, the status page at status.yieldify.com has been deactivated, and no pricing is published anywhere.

providers.name: Agrofy
providers.description: Agrofy is a Latin American agribusiness technology company founded in 2015 in Rosario, Argentina, operating the region's largest online marketplace for agricultural inputs, machinery, farmland, vehicles and services. The company runs three business units — Agrofy Market (the marketplace, live in Argentina and Brazil with country storefronts across Bolivia, Chile, Colombia, Paraguay, Peru and Uruguay), Agrofy News (an agricultural news publication) and Agrofy Pay (payments, credit and financing for agribusiness transactions). Agrofy markets a partner integration program, Agrofy Developers, for sellers who want to automate listings and lead management inside the marketplace.

providers.name: Evvy
providers.description: Evvy is a women's health company offering at-home vaginal microbiome testing and personalized care. Its CLIA-certified metagenomic (mNGS) Vaginal Health Test identifies over 700 bacteria and fungi from a self-collected sample, with results reviewed by licensed clinicians who deliver personalized insights and clinician-designed treatment programs for conditions such as bacterial vaginosis, aerobic vaginitis, yeast infections, recurrent UTIs, and fertility-related concerns. Evvy also sells a line of vaginal health products including probiotics and boric-acid, hyaluronic-acid, and probiotic suppositories, plus a provider program for clinicians and a large library of science-backed educational content. Backed by General Catalyst, Evvy was surfaced as a portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. Evvy is a direct-to-consumer health and e-commerce business and does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Kitterly
providers.description: Kitterly, Inc. was a direct-to-consumer craft commerce startup that sold knitting and crochet kits, yarn, needles and notions online, and ran a monthly Kit Club subscription that shipped members a pattern plus the yarn required to complete it. Kitterly was backed by 500 Global (500 Startups) along with Manatt Ventures and the Jordan x 2080 accelerator. The company was later consolidated under the Cotton Cuts brand, a Chesterfield, Missouri based quilting fabric shop selling designer die-cut and pre-cut fabric, threads, patterns and notions, plus quilting memberships and the Puzzle Mystery Quilt program, serving roughly 4,000 members across more than 15 countries. The kitterly.com domain now redirects to cottoncuts.com. The business is a consumer retail and subscription commerce operation running on a hosted e-commerce platform, and it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs or machine-readable specifications.

providers.name: PayPro Global
providers.description: PayPro Global is an all-in-one Merchant of Record platform that lets SaaS, software, video game, and AI tool companies sell globally. The platform handles international payments, subscription billing, tax compliance, fraud prevention, and revenue recovery, and exposes APIs and webhooks for managing subscriptions, payments, and customer data.

providers.name: Storefront
providers.description: Storefront (thestorefront.com) is an online marketplace for renting short-term commercial retail space, connecting brands, e-commerce businesses, and artists with space owners to launch pop-up shops, showrooms, galleries, product launches, and events. The platform lists tens of thousands of spaces across 50+ cities in North America, Europe, and Asia, with flexible day/week/month rentals and a secure booking-and-payment flow, 24-hour support, and a Priority Pass membership. Storefront was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Point Nine and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal (api.thestorefront.com is private/401), so this profile captures company identity and public web properties only.

providers.name: KoRo
providers.description: KoRo (KoRo Handels GmbH) is a Berlin-based direct-to-consumer food retailer that sells nuts, dried fruit, nut butters, snacks, protein products, baking ingredients and drugstore goods in bulk packaging at wholesale-style prices, shipping across Europe from country storefronts in Germany (korodrogerie.de), Austria, Switzerland, France, Italy and the Benelux/EU shop at koro.com. Founded in 2014 and backed by HV Capital and Partech, KoRo runs a headless commerce stack — a Shopware 6 backend fronted by a Nuxt storefront deployed on Vercel — and publishes its engineering work as open source through the KoRoHandelsGmbH GitHub organization, including a Nitro-based Shopware Store-API proxy and several Shopware 6 build-tooling packages on npm under the @korodrogerie scope. KoRo publishes no public developer portal, no documented partner or commerce API, and no API specifications; its Store-API surface is internal and gated behind per-sales-channel access keys.

providers.name: Linnworks
providers.description: Linnworks provides a multichannel inventory and order management platform for small and medium-sized e‑commerce businesses. Their SaaS solution centralises inventory, automates order processing, integrates with multiple marketplaces and shipping carriers, and offers AI‑driven forecasting and reporting tools. The platform aims to help retailers scale operations across channels while reducing manual effort and errors.

providers.name: ARVI SA
providers.description: ARVI SA operates a premium online wine shop offering a curated selection of over 5,000 fine and rare wines from renowned regions such as Bordeaux, Burgundy, and Tuscany. Based in Switzerland, the company provides secure shipping and 24‑hour delivery throughout the country. Customers can browse an extensive catalog, filter by producer, vintage, price, and region, and purchase directly through the website. The platform emphasizes high‑quality service, authenticity guarantees, and a seamless shopping experience for wine enthusiasts and collectors.

providers.name: Atolls
providers.description: Atolls (formerly Global Savings Group) is a Munich-based consumer commerce-content company that operates the world's largest shopping engagement platform, running coupon, cashback, deals, and shopping-community destinations across more than 20 markets. Its brand portfolio includes Coupons.com, Cuponation, iGraal, Shoop, Pouch, mydealz, hotukdeals, and Deala, connecting millions of shoppers with offers from thousands of retailers and brands through affiliate marketing, cashback, and AI-enhanced shopping insights. Founded in 2012 as CupoNation with Rocket Internet and rebranded to Atolls in 2024, it is backed by investors including HV Capital, RTP Global, and Rocket Internet. Atolls publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI document or SDK — api., developer. and docs.atolls.com do not resolve — but it does serve real machine-readable documents: RFC 9116 security.txt files on five owned hosts pointing at a single group-wide Intigriti vulnerability disclosure program, and OpenID Connect discovery documents on seven Pepper community properties (mydealz, hotukdeals, Dealabs, Preisjaeger, Chollometro, Pepper PL, Promodescuentos) that expose an OAuth 2.0 authorization server for consumer sign-in. This profile captures that security, identity, and legal surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: BLOCKTRUST
providers.description: BLOCKTRUST provides a French digital identity certification solution that protects against identity theft and phishing. Leveraging blockchain on Polygon, it offers monthly subscription plans, customizable verification tools, and compliance with European data protection standards. The platform enables businesses and individuals to securely verify identities, reduce fraud, and integrate trusted digital credentials into their services.

providers.name: Choco Communications
providers.description: Choco Communications provides an AI‑powered growth platform for food distributors, enabling automated ordering, digital storefronts, sales tools, and payment solutions. The platform helps businesses increase margins, reduce waste, and streamline restaurant‑supplier communication through real‑time insights and integrated CRM features.

providers.name: Minoan
providers.description: Minoan is a hospitality procurement and shoppable-stays platform. Short-term-rental hosts, property managers, hotels, and interior designers source furniture, decor, and home goods at insider/trade pricing through Minoan's purchasing platform, and earn revenue share when guests buy the items they experienced during a stay. Founded to turn every hosted space into a shoppable showroom, Minoan connects properties to hundreds of home-and-lifestyle brands and handles sourcing, checkout, and fulfillment. Backed by Accel. As of this profile Minoan exposes no public developer API; this record captures its public web, security, and llms.txt surface.

providers.name: Nfinite
providers.description: Nfinite (formerly Hubstairs) is a visual intelligence platform for the digital shelf. It helps consumer brands and retailers automatically analyze, generate, and monitor compliant product visuals — detecting visual compliance gaps across every retailer and brand and fixing them at scale using AI-generated 3D and synthetic product imagery. The product is delivered as a web application (my.nfinite.app) rather than a public developer API; no OpenAPI, developer portal, or published documentation exists at the time of enrichment. Backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Our Place
providers.description: Our Place is a direct-to-consumer kitchenware and cookware brand, best known for the multi-purpose Always Pan, selling cookware, bakeware, appliances, tableware, and kitchen tools at fromourplace.com. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc, its digital storefront runs on Shopify and exposes a native agentic-commerce surface: a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile, a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) shopping endpoint, Shopify Customer Account OpenID Connect authentication, and an agent-facing llms.txt / agents.md. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from the company's live public agent surface.

providers.name: Jinx
providers.description: Jinx is a direct-to-consumer pet nutrition brand selling premium dog and cat food, toppers, and treats at thinkjinx.com. Its product lines span dry kibble, wet food (pate, stews, homestyle), fresh refrigerated meals, jerky and training treats, and meal toppers, formulated with high-quality proteins, probiotics, and superfoods. Backed by Initialized Capital, Jinx sells online and through retail partners. The storefront runs on Shopify; it exposes no first-party public developer API, but the store's Shopify Customer Account API OIDC/OAuth discovery is served live from the domain and is captured in this profile.

providers.name: Mar Egeu
providers.description: Mar Egeu is a family‑owned Brazilian swimwear manufacturer founded in 1971 in São Paulo. They design, develop and produce high‑quality swimwear for brands worldwide, offering custom designs, premium fabrics, and international shipping to over 100 countries. Their website showcases collections, pricing, and a full guide for partners looking to launch their own swimwear line.

providers.name: Spark Shipping
providers.description: Spark Shipping provides an eCommerce dropshipping automation platform that enables merchants to import products with one click, synchronize inventory and pricing across multiple vendors, generate AI-powered product descriptions, and automate order routing and tracking updates. Their SaaS solution integrates with major marketplaces and shopping carts, offering tools for inventory management, price automation, and vendor integrations to streamline online retail operations.

providers.name: Strikingly
providers.description: Strikingly is a mobile-first website builder platform that enables users to create gorgeous, mobile-optimized websites without coding. The platform provides tools for managing site content, sections, blog posts, store products, form submissions, and membership settings through its web interface and internal REST APIs.

providers.name: SyncSpider
providers.description: SyncSpider provides eCommerce automation and integration tools for online shops, multivendor marketplaces, and brick‑and‑mortar stores. It enables businesses to sync inventory, orders, and product data across platforms, offering a universal API layer that simplifies complex integrations and streamlines operations for retailers and partners.

providers.name: TNL Mediagene
providers.description: TNL Mediagene is a next-generation digital and technology media group serving millennial and Gen Z audiences across Asia. Formed from the 2023 merger of Taiwan's The News Lens and Japan's Mediagene, the group operates more than twenty media brands spanning news, business, technology, lifestyle, and sports — including The News Lens, INSIDE, Cool3c, Gizmodo Japan, Business Insider Japan, Lifehacker Japan, Roomie, and licensed titles such as Digiday Japan and Glossy Japan. Beyond publishing, the company runs advertising and marketing technology (the Ad2iction DSP), an AI-driven customer data and audience analytics platform, e-commerce properties, and market-research services. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global and is listed on Nasdaq as TNMG. The group publishes no developer portal, no OpenAPI, and no SDK. Its one public, machine-readable integration surface is the Ad2iction header-bidding adapter shipped inside Prebid.js — a first-party-maintained open-source module that posts bid requests to https://ads.ad2iction.com/html/prebid/, documented on the Prebid.org bidder registry rather than on a TNL Mediagene developer site.

providers.name: Cubyn
providers.description: Cubyn is a Paris‑based logistics platform founded in 2014 that provides e‑commerce merchants with end‑to‑end fulfillment services, including parcel delivery, B2B shipments, freight, custom packaging, and reverse logistics. Their cloud‑based solution integrates with major marketplaces and shop platforms such as Shopify and Prestashop, offering real‑time inventory and order tracking. Cubyn ceased operations in 2024, but its former services aimed to give online retailers a high‑performance network for fast, cost‑effective deliveries worldwide.

providers.name: El-Dokan
providers.description: El-Dokan (El Dokan Software) is a Cairo, Egypt-based enterprise eCommerce software company founded in 2019 that provides an API-first, headless and composable commerce platform for the MENA region. Its 300+ REST API endpoints and developer tools let brands and retailers make any digital experience shoppable across web, mobile apps, POS, and multi-vendor marketplaces, supporting B2C, D2C, B2B, and marketplace models with 100+ payment, shipping, SMS, and ERP integrations and MENA localization. Customers include Procter & Gamble, Misr Pharmacies, Mobily, Zahran, Switch Plus, and Appetito. El-Dokan raised a $550,000 pre-seed round in 2022 backed by Flat6Labs, EFG EV, 500 Global, and Hala Ventures. Public API documentation (data model, getting started, and API reference) is gated behind a get-access signup.

providers.name: Listia
providers.description: Listia is a peer-to-peer marketplace where members give away and acquire secondhand goods using an internal virtual currency ("Points") rather than cash. Launched in 2009 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz, the service lets members list unwanted items in auction-style listings, earn Points when an item sells, and spend those Points to claim items from other members — a closed-loop credit-and-reputation economy layered on a classic online-auction flow. The site reports over 10 million members, operates iOS and Android apps alongside the web marketplace, and runs adjacent programs including Listia Rewards (redeeming Points for gift cards and retail goods) and Listia Assurance (buyer and seller protection). Listia publishes no public developer program: there is no developer portal, no API documentation, no OpenAPI or other machine-readable specification, and no first-party SDKs on npm, PyPI, RubyGems or Packagist. The api.listia.com host serves the same Rails application as the website and acts as the private backend for the mobile apps, not a documented public API.

providers.name: Butternut Box
providers.description: Butternut Box is a London-headquartered direct-to-consumer pet nutrition company that cooks and delivers fresh, gently-steamed dog food on a personalised subscription. Customers complete an online profiling wizard covering their dog's breed, age, weight, activity level and health needs, and Butternut Box calculates a portioned meal plan from human-quality meat and vegetables, batch-cooks it at low temperature, freezes it, and ships it on a recurring schedule. Founded in 2016 and certified as a B Corporation, the company operates nine locale storefronts covering the United Kingdom, Ireland, the Netherlands, Belgium (Dutch and French), Germany, Italy, Sweden and Denmark, and runs its own production facility alongside a React / React Native / Ruby on Rails engineering stack. Butternut Box publishes no public developer API, developer portal or machine-readable specification; its customer-facing surfaces are the marketing site, the subscription web app and the iOS/Android apps.

providers.name: Linas Matkasse
providers.description: Linas Matkasse is a Swedish meal-kit subscription service that delivers pre-portioned ingredients and nutritionally calculated recipes to customers' homes each week. Customers pick from more than 150 weekly recipes across concepts such as Chef's Choice, Family Favorites, Quick & Easy, Calorie-Smart, Vegetarian, Gluten-Free and Lactose-Free, and can change their selection until Tuesday night before a Saturday-to-Monday delivery. The brand is operated by Cheffelo, a Scandinavian meal-kit group listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market that also runs Godtlevert in Norway and RetNemt in Denmark and delivers roughly 17 million meals a year. Linas Matkasse runs a consumer subscription e-commerce storefront and a "Mina Sidor" customer account area; it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Max Retail
providers.description: Max Retail is a Techstars-backed platform that helps brick-and-mortar boutiques and multi-location retailers turn unsold and aged inventory into cash. Retailers connect their point-of-sale or e-commerce system — Shopify, RICS, or Square — or upload a CSV, and Max Retail lists, markets, and sells the items to a network of shoppers across multiple channels, handles customer service, and pays out through Stripe when a prepaid shipping label is scanned. The retailer only ships; Max Retail charges a flat 15% fee plus shipping. Max Retail integrates inbound with third-party commerce platforms and payment processors but does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a webhook surface of its own.

providers.name: Tory Burch
providers.description: Tory Burch LLC is an American luxury women's fashion label founded in February 2004 by designer Tory Burch and headquartered in New York City, trading under the legal entity River Light V, L.P. The privately held company designs and sells ready-to-wear clothing, designer shoes, handbags, small leather goods, jewellery, watches, eyewear, fragrance and beauty, swimwear and home decor, together with the Tory Sport activewear line, through roughly 400 boutiques worldwide, wholesale partners and a direct-to-consumer storefront at toryburch.com serving the United States, United Kingdom, the European Union and Asia. Its affiliated Tory Burch Foundation funds and educates women entrepreneurs. Tory Burch is a fashion and retail business rather than a software vendor: it operates no developer program, publishes no API documentation, SDKs or machine-readable API contract, and holds no public GitHub organisation. Its storefront is a Next.js front end on Akamai over a Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Demandware) commerce platform with Adobe Scene7 media, and an Apigee API gateway fronts www.toryburch.com/api/ for first-party storefront traffic only, exposing no publicly registered proxy. The one machine-readable artifact the company does publish is a site-wide llms.txt.

providers.name: Unicorn Auctions
providers.description: Unicorn Auctions is a Chicago-based online auction marketplace for rare spirits and fine wine, founded in 2019 by A.J. Heindel, Cody Modeer and Phil Mikhaylov out of the city's restaurant and bar trade. Every lot is sold on consignment: Unicorn authenticates, appraises, photographs and digitizes each bottle before listing it in one to three weekly online auctions that can carry several thousand lots spanning bourbon, scotch, Japanese whisky, tequila, agave spirits and wine. The company also runs a bonded vault storage service for collectors, and publishes The Unicorn Review, an editorial and auction-intelligence blog. Bidding is entirely digital, through the web platform and native iOS and Android apps. Unicorn Auctions publishes no public developer program - no OpenAPI, SDK, webhook catalog or developer portal - and the api.unicornauctions.com backend that serves its own clients is private, undocumented and disallowed in robots.txt.

providers.name: BoxGreen
providers.description: BoxGreen (BoxGreen Pte. Ltd., incorporated 2014 in Singapore) is a Certified B Corporation and social enterprise selling all-natural, individually packaged healthy snacks direct to consumers and to businesses. Its consumer offering is a Shopify-based e-commerce store with build-your-own snack boxes, curated collections (nut mixes, crunchies, vegan and gluten-free ranges), gift and party packs, and a subscription delivery model; its B2B side covers corporate gifting, office pantry supply, and cashless healthy-snack vending machines. Every BoxGreen snack is packed in prison by beneficiaries of Singapore's Yellow Ribbon Project to build skills and employability. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company, BoxGreen publishes no first-party API or developer program; the only machine-readable surface on its domain is Shopify's New Customer Accounts OIDC/OAuth discovery.
